records.name: 1-ml-of-water
records.prompt: Generate ONLY an isolated cast-shadow PLUS transmitted/reflected caustic-light texture for a single spherical water droplet. Broad almost circular wall shadow, mildly dark refractive rim with one restrained concentrated crescent and small soft focal patch of pale lavender light, no glass bowl rim. Input1 is the actual water object whose 3D optical volume must inform the shadow. Input2 is the accepted wall cube shadow study. Input3 is the ORIGINAL shared sphere shadow; match its strong upper-left dark region transitioning to softer more transparent lower-right edges. The receiver is a VERTICAL WALL / POSTER parallel to camera screen, behind the floating object, NEVER a horizontal floor. The shadow is broad and substantial in height, no flattened puddle or ground ellipse. Upper-left/front illumination casts the shape down-right in use; center the complete shadow-light artwork at canvas center now, with NO positional offset because registration happens in code. Light should be softly focused pale purple/lavender, with restrained near-white lavender accents that blend naturally over a deep purple #48339a wall. Shadow is neutral translucent black with a strong near rim but transparent interior appropriate to water. Caustics are light projected onto the wall, not highlights on a visible object. No rendered water object, sphere, fishbowl, tank, 3D surfaces, floor, wall rectangle, lettering, checkerboard, or opaque backdrop. True transparent PNG alpha, square1254, shadow-light footprint fills about 65-70% canvas width and height, centered with full clear margins. Progressive blur and alpha fading. Produce a cohesive family matching the existing lighting. Baseline near-wall state only; extra displacement, blur, dimming and enlargement on hover come from code.
